text: The second choice is On this computer, and it's experimental. Codex then runs on the computer itself, not in the sealed environment. It can do anything you can do. It can read, change and delete any of your files, use your apps and your browser, and act with your accounts. It might even be able to reach UM-Codex's own key, because it runs as you. Use it only when you need Codex to control the computer or the browser.
